content:
I fooled myself again and again throughout this challenge.


These 29 days taught me a lot not just about consistency but about my own mistakes, mindset, and the way I was approaching this challenge.

And honestly there are some things I realised only after doing them.

I’ve written down every mistake I made in this series the small ones the big ones and the ones I didn’t even realise were mistakes at the time.

But I’m not telling you today 👀

Tomorrow is Day 30.

And tomorrow, I’m putting everything on the post .
No pretending I did it perfectly ( absolutely not )

Just what I did, what I realised and what these 30 days actually taught me.

See you tomorrow 
tab tak ke liye byee byee 😌
comment: The interesting part of long challenges is often the feedback loop, not the streak itself. The mistakes usually reveal where the process needs redesign rather than just more discipline.
